# QR Code generator (C)

A QR code encoder in C99, by Project Nayuki, MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`,
from its README).

Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator, release `v1.8.0`
(commit 720f62bddb7226106071d4728c292cb1df519ceb). `qrcodegen.c` and
`qrcodegen.h` are copied unchanged from its `c/` directory.

Online Games' Quick Connect shows the page to link the game at as a QR code
with it (`port/linux/src/browser.c`); it builds into the Linux, macOS,
Windows and Android platform layers.
